latestVersion.changelog:
browser-generator-cartoon 1.0.0

- Initial release: generate cartoon videos directly in the browser using cloud GPUs—no animation software or downloads required.
- Accepts text prompts or uploads (MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF, up to 200MB) and delivers 1080p MP4 cartoon animations, ready to download.
- Authenticates automatically, granting 100 free credits with a temporary token; setup requires no manual configuration.
- Exposes workflows for upload, generation, editing, export, credits, and state tracking through natural prompts and keyword routing.
- Implements robust error handling for session, credits, format, and rate-limit issues with clear user guidance.
- Includes helpful tips for producing the best animation results and supports common user workflows for fast video creation.
